title: Reading Drill — Keeping Track of Shared Bicycles
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Keeping Track of Shared Bicycles
passages.body:
**A** A college lending scheme started with a handwritten list of bicycles. Borrowers described faults in their own words, so the adviser had to check several terms that might mean the same problem with the brakes.

**B** To make reports easier to sort, the adviser introduced three broad categories and kept a comment box for anything those categories did not cover. Borrowers could also leave the bicycle number.

**C** The change helped the technician see repeated faults. Bikes with frequent reports were inspected before each loan even if they had recently had a service. The intention was to detect intermittent problems.
